description: Computation only: per-edition differences (license, billing_period for a subscription or rent-to-own edition, formats, OS, capabilities, cheapest known cost over the offers this channel may disclose, budget fit) for 2 to 10 edition ids under the same channel policy as resolve_purchase_request. Each row has canonical_page and site_entry_page. canonical_page is the product page on this site; it carries the complete price table (including listings withheld on this channel), the merchant purchase links and the affiliate disclosure. site_entry_page is the same page with the entry marker for this channel. cheapest_cost is taken from the default confirmed-route class first, as in resolve_purchase_request; an edition with a cheaper confirmed listing outside that class is named in assumptions (key cheapest_cost_default_route_first, value the edition id, note_ja with the amount). An edition with no price in the requested currency keeps cheapest_cost in the original currency, with budget_fit unknown and the assumption key cheapest_cost_foreign_currency (value the edition id); cheapest_cost may carry converted (a yen estimate: amount_minor, display such as 約¥7,800, rate_source ecb_eurofxref, rate_reference_date, rate_basis direct or cross_via_eur, and basis_note, a fixed English sentence saying that this site computed the estimate from the European Central Bank's reference rates of that date and that it is not a price) that is not used for ordering, budget fit, cheapest cost or lowest_observed. Each row's price_checked_at is the check time of that price. Stale offers (past fresh_until) are not used for cheapest_cost. A row whose edition the site has measured itself also carries measurements in full: environment (host machine, OS, DAW and version, audio interface, sample rate, buffer size, tools), product_version, settings, measured_at, comparison conditions, procedure, results ({ value, decimals } per named field), runs and result_statistic, failure cases, material rights and disclosure. They are not a sound-quality rating and not part of differing_fields; numbers compare only between editions listed in compared_edition_ids. Bounded compute class (shared with POST /api/v1/compare). Links are user_navigation handoffs (handoff_mode=user_navigation) and are not intended for prefetching or automatic clicking.
name: compare_products
title: Compare editions
